## Use {{Product}} from an AI agent
- MCP endpoint: {{https://app.example.com}}/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP)
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, or a URL-only connector: {{https://app.example.com}}/api/mcp/<key>
- Get a key: {{https://app.example.com}}/settings/ai (shown once; acts with your permissions)
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http {{slug}} {{https://app.example.com}}/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <key>"`
- CLI: `npm i -g {{slug}}` then `{{slug}} key <key>` and `{{slug}} tools`
